mn124:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā bakkulo rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.

mn124:39.1: labheyyāhaṃ āvuso bakkula, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
mn124:39.2: alattha kho acelakassapo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
mn124:39.3: acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā kassapo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti. tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhevadhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
mn124:39.4: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
mn124:39.5: aññataro kho panāyasmā kassapo arahataṃ ahosi.
mn124:40.1: atha kho āyasmā bakkulo aparena samayena apāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihārena vihāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāha:
mn124:40.3: yampāyasmā bakkulo apāpuraṇaṃ ādāya vihārena vihāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā evamāha: ‘abhikkamathāyasmanto, abhikkamathāyasmanto, ajja me parinibbānaṃ bhavissatī’ti. idampi mayaṃ āyasmato bākulassa acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhārema. atha kho
mn124:41.1: āyasmā bakkulo majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinnakova parinibbāyi.
mn124:41.2: yampāyasmā bakkulo majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinnakova parinibbāyi. idampi mayaṃ āyasmato bakkulassa acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremāti.
